text:
Ravi M: quick heads-up  found tenants sending both X-API-Version: v2 and legacy token affinity, but theys getting routed to v1. Repro in post.
Tess L: can you paste the curl?
Ravi M: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer tok_abc" -H "X-API-Version: v2" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat` -> routed to v1 nodes. Token had no version metadata.
Omar N: That's because token affinity currently wins if present; header is secondary. We're seeing implicit assumptions in downstream tooling that token==source-of-truth.
Elena B: Customers expect header to override in many SDKs. Changing global precedence is risky. Suggest: audit-mode first, then opt-in per-tenant.
Tess L: +1. Minimal plan: 1) add an audit flag that records "would_have_used_header" for sampled requests; 2) surface a per-tenant toggle in Console; 3) projection job to estimate pool shifts and quota impact.
Omar N: implement audit as a trace tag and metric `routing.header_wouldwin.sampled` with tag `tenant_id`. Keep sampling <=1% by default.
Ravi M: For projection, compute sessions that would switch pools and estimate cost delta; show on tenant page with a clear warning.
Elena B: Also add safety: if opt-in causes sustained error increase (2x baseline for 4m), auto-revert the tenant and page oncall.
Tess L: console copy: "Prefer client header" toggle; button "Estimate impact" runs a one-off projection. UX should default to audit-only unless tenant enables.
Omar N: add metric `routing.version_override.count` with `source=header|token` and a small dashboard tile showing sample rate & projected pool movement.
ops-bot: Created ENG-4510: "header-precedence audit + per-tenant opt-in + projection" assigned to @Omar N and @Tess L. ETA 6 days for audit + dashboard sketch.
Ravi M: I'll follow up with a short support note & SDK guidance: avoid sending conflicting signals.
Elena B: good. Let's keep sampling conservative and review after one week before any wider rollouts.
